content.text:
Mistral just released a 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model, and its standout skill is cybersecurity. 🔐

**Mistral Large 4** (affectionately nicknamed "Le Chonk") is now on Hugging Face.

**The specs:**
• ~1T total parameters, ~49B active (Mixture-of-Experts, 4 of 128 experts + 1 shared per token)
• 1M token context window
• Multimodal: text + images in, text out (1.6B Pixtral vision encoder)
• Two kinds of sparsity: MoE picks *which experts* run, while a DeepSeek-style sparse attention indexer picks *which tokens* to attend to

**Why the cyber results stand out:**
On a test that asks a model to reproduce a real vulnerability in open-source software and then patch it, Mistral Large 4 scored **82%**, the highest reported score on that task. Mistral reports that several closed frontier models score near zero because they refuse to attempt it.

That matters for defenders. You usually can't fix a vulnerability without reproducing it first, and incident response often looks like an attack to a content filter. With open weights, your team controls the deployment and isn't locked out mid-incident.

It isn't a free-for-all, though. On cyber prompts from JailbreakBench, StrongREJECT and AgentHarm, it has the **highest average refusal rate of any open-weight model**.

**Other highlights:**
• 93% on Cybench (40 security competition challenges)
• 61.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, and a Coding Agent Index score ahead of DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen3.8 Max
• #5 open-weights model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index

**You can run it today:**
Day-0 support in Transformers, vLLM, llama.cpp, and TRL for fine-tuning. The 2-bit GGUF even runs on a single 512GB Apple Silicon Ultra (~15 tok/s generation).

A verifiable reproduce-then-patch task combined with open weights is a strong base for building and RL-training smaller, specialised security models. I'm curious to see what the community builds.

Would you trust an open-weight model in your security workflow? 👇

#AI #OpenSource #Cybersecurity #LLM #MachineLearning #Mistral #HuggingFace

---

**A note on the source:** the article says "~49B active parameters," but the model ID is `Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B`, which suggests 52B. I used the article's 49B figure, but you may want to check before posting.
